budget_note: Three spec candidates carry the canvas, so each of the canvas's two diagrams saw three candidates — the per-diagram budget. The trunk-fan geometry, the round's flagship risk, also needed three throwaway shape probes; they are listed under abandoned_shapes with their record labels, as the skill requires for exploratory probes beyond the view budget.

Node ids chosen so the engine's id-ordered rank puts the Power shelf in the middle of the OOB fan: the trunk corridor now descends straight into its own target and the bus itself has ZERO near-miss cells. abandoned_shapes.purpose: Read the round-13 check vocabulary before spending a candidate: does a canvas print per-diagram origin/extent/description lines, does a trunk with two branches plus a corridor terminus report one junction, and does `near-miss:` name the offending route and node?
abandoned_shapes.result: Confirmed all four. A 9-node toy canvas reported 'trunks: p1:t1 from b to e, 2 branches, 1 junctions' and three named near-miss lines. Never shipped.

abandoned_shapes.purpose: Find out what decides within-rank order, because the trunk corridor only stays clear of unrelated boxes if its terminus is the middle box of the fan. Four nodes declared zz, aa, mm — rendered Alpha, Mu, Zeta.
abandoned_shapes.result: Within-rank order is id-lexicographic, not declaration order. That is why canvas-v2's reordering failed and canvas-v3 renames the ids instead (bmc_c < pwr < sw). Never shipped.

abandoned_shapes.purpose: Three fan geometries in one canvas — (a) tb fan with the terminus centred, (b) lr stack with the terminus at the bottom, (c) tb with the terminus pinned one rank under the branches — to find one where a three-way trunk split keeps every route clear of the boxes it does not serve.
abandoned_shapes.result: All three fail: (a) 6 + 13 cells at ring 2 of the centred terminus, (b) 6 corridor + 4 arm cells at ring 2, (c) 18 corridor cells at ring 2 in the three-cell gap between the branch boxes. 53 cells total. This is the evidence for the structural yield recorded in generation.json. Never shipped.
